title: Anchored-eval acceptance harness for automated batching/cache applies
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated acceptance harness that validates batching/caching configuration recommendations before they are auto-applied. The harness will run against an anchored reference corpus (aka anchor prompts) and a small per-tenant sample corpus, compute statistical signals (paired bootstrap, effect sizes, and confidence intervals) on semantic and surface metrics, and decide pass/fail per-rule. The goal is to allow safe, low-latency application of cost-saving configs while limiting quality regressions and providing clear rollback triggers and human-in-the-loop review boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: A headless job runs for any proposal from the cost advisor and produces a signed acceptance artifact within 10 minutes for typical corpus sizes (<= 500 prompts)
The harness reports at least three metric families: semantic similarity (embedding cosine delta), model logprob change (mean delta), and task-specific surface metrics (BLEU/ROUGE where applicable)
A statistical decision engine applies configurable thresholds (p < 0.05 with bootstrap + minimum effect size) and returns PASS / WARN / FAIL with rationale
When FAIL is returned, the apply flow is blocked and a rollback action is created if the change was already partially rolled out
When WARN is returned, the change is promoted to canary mode with 5% traffic and an automated monitoring window of 24 hours before full apply
Artifacts (raw outputs, metric logs, and decision payload) are stored in S3 and linked on the recommendation record
Integrations exist for manual review in Console: reviewers can approve, require more samples, or reject
End-to-end tests (unit + integration) are added and run in CI with synthetic corpora that cover edge cases (short prompts, multi-turn context, high-entropy outputs)
test_plan: 1) Smoke: run harness locally against stored anchor prompts (n=50) and verify PASS/WARN/FAIL outcomes are deterministically reproducible
2) Statistical validation: run bootstrap-based significance tests and verify p-values align with known synthetic perturbations
3) Canary flow: simulate a WARN outcome and validate canary routing + 24h monitor + auto-promote only on green metrics
4) Rollback flow: force a FAIL after partial apply and verify automatic rollback action is created and executed, and that an incident ticket is generated
5) Per-tenant check: validate harness runs with tenant sampling enabled and respects PII redaction and dataset size limits
6) Performance: verify harness completes within SLOs for 100/250/500 prompt workloads (target median < 6 minutes for 500 prompts)
updates: 2026-02-25: Created ticket. Initial scope focused on anchored prompts + per-tenant sampling. Decided to use embedding-based semantic deltas as primary signal.
2026-03-02: Spike complete. Demonstrated paired bootstrap test on synthetic corpora. Found that mean logprob shifts are noisy for short prompts; added min-sample-size gating.
2026-03-05: Design review with PM and SRE. PM (Jules Han) requested per-customer opt-out flag. SRE requested retention policy for artifacts (90 days).
2026-03-08: Trade-off discussion: strict p-value blocking causes high false negatives on low-signal tasks; agreed on two-tier decision: statistical + effect-size threshold to reduce Type II errors.
2026-03-12: Implementation PRs opened for eval-runner and cost-advisor integration. CI flaky on windows build; flagged to infra (ENG-70500).
risks: False positives: small but meaningful regressions could be missed if corpora are not representative
Latency: long-running evaluation jobs could delay low-cost high-value applies; mitigation is to allow staged canaries
Storage and cost: storing raw outputs for 90 days increases S3 costs; need lifecycle policy
Adversarial prompts: malicious customers could craft prompts that bias the test; require per-tenant review and sampling limits
next_actions: Merge eval-runner PR and hand off to infra for staged rollout
Add console UI for manual review and override with audit log
Implement lifecycle policy for artifacts and add S3 bucket with encryption and KMS keys
Schedule 1-hour demo for CS and Solutions to review canary behavior and escalation paths
